title: feat(app-shell): Setup › Installed Apps shows app updates, folds modules under their app, and leaves the developer doors to Studio
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBA6p6wR5XRGmnECFZqr87FM)_

Fixes #34722

Clause-②: yes (widening — locale keys only)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：设置 › 已安装应用现在会标出应用市场里有新版本的应用（"有可用更新 → vX"，点击进入该应用的市场页去升级），页首说明有几个应用可升级；一个应用一行，它带的模块包折叠在应用下面按需展开；列改为名称/版本/状态/来源/更新；导入、新建包、平台包开关和"显示全部"只留在 Studio 的包页。
- **为什么改**：管理员在已安装应用里看不到哪些应用该升级，也被内部 ID、Scope、开发者按钮和逐个模块的长列表淹没（#34722，ADR-0146 D1 / ADR-0130 D2）。
- **风险与回滚**：只改前端一个页面在 `?source=marketplace` 时的绘制，Studio 包页（同一组件、不带 source）不变；市场读不到时列表照常显示并加一行说明，绝不显示"已是最新"。回滚＝回退本 PR，无数据或接口变化。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` 的 `readUpdateTargets`（何时算"读不到"）与 `appOfModule`（模块归属哪个应用）；`console/marketplace/__tests__/marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts` 新增的 hook-gated 门；`PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx`，预期 16 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无,席位落地

## What changes

Setup › Installed Apps is the `developer:packages` component opened with `?source=marketplace` (Setup's `nav_marketplace_installed`); Studio › Packages is the same component with no params. The view is told apart by the existing `installedAppsView` flag, so Studio's door is untouched.

| | Before | After (Setup › Installed Apps only) |
|---|---|---|
| Update information | none | the marketplace's own `UpdateAvailableBadge` ("Update available → v6.4.0") plus "Upgrade", linked to `/system/marketplace/PACKAGE_ID` (the route the Details action already opens); a header line "N apps have a newer version in the marketplace." |
| Catalog unreadable / no marketplace | n/a | the list renders as before plus one line: "Update information can’t be read from the marketplace right now, so this list can’t say which apps have a newer version." Never drawn as up to date. |
| Modules | every package its own row | a `type: 'module'` package that declares exactly one installed app (same source) in `manifest.dependencies` is folded under that app's line; a toggle (aria-expanded, aria-controls) shows it. This is the same tie the server's `isDisableableAppModule` reads. A module declaring two apps, or none in view, stays its own line. A search that hits a module shows it under its app. |
| Columns | Name, ID, Version, Scope, Status, Source, Actions | Name, Version, Status, Source, Update, Actions |
| Developer doors | Import, New Package, Show platform packages, "Source: Marketplace · Show all" chip | none of them on this view; Studio › Packages keeps all four |

How the update is decided: for each app line that has an install-ledger entry, `getMarketplacePackage(packageId)` is read once. The latest version is `package.latest_version?.version ?? versions[0]?.version`, and the badge shows only when `updateTarget(installed, latest)` (the marketplace pages' own rule) answers a version. A 404 means not listed (no badge, no note). Any other failure, or `isMarketplaceEnabled()` false, means unavailable (the note). Modules are never asked about.

The namespace gate (decision Q1 = A on the claim amendment): the badge's words live only in the lazy `marketplace` namespace. `InstalledAppUpdateCell` calls `useMarketplaceNamespace()`. While the read or the namespace is loading, the cell holds a skeleton placeholder, never an empty "up to date" cell. When the namespace is ready, it draws `UpdateAvailableBadge`. When the namespace fails, it still shows "→ v6.4.0" and the Upgrade link. `marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts` gains one declared hook-gated door (`UpdateAvailableBadge.tsx` drawn only from `PackagesPage.tsx`) and asserts through the TypeScript AST that the importer imports and calls the hook. The eager language pack does not grow: this branch has 0 diff lines under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/`.

Strings: nine keys added to the lazy `studio` namespace in en and zh (`engine.packages.installedApps.col.update`, `.upgrade`, `.updatesSummaryOne`, `.updatesSummary`, `.updatesUnavailable`, `.modulesOne`, `.modules`, `.showModules`, `.hideModules`).

Docs: `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` said Installed Apps lists "each package of a suite as its own row", which this change makes false. Two sentences now say one line per app, with modules folded under it.

Not done here, as the card says: the upgrade flow itself (the link lands on the existing marketplace page), plans and permissions, and the packaged-actions page (#34724).

### Narrowing: the developer doors leave Setup › Installed Apps

Import, New Package, the platform-packages switch and the Source chip's "Show all" are no longer drawn when the page is opened with `?source=marketplace` (Q2 = A for the chip). Studio › Packages keeps all of them. These tests pin it:

- `PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx` › "the two doors (objectstack#34722)":
  - "Setup → Installed Apps draws the administrator columns and none of the developer doors"
  - "Studio → Packages keeps Import, New Package, the platform switch and the developer columns, and asks no catalog"
  - "Studio → Packages filtered to another Source keeps its Show all chip"
- `PackagesPage.source-12675.test.tsx`:
  - "`?source=marketplace` shows only the marketplace rows, with no Show all that clears it" (replaces the old pin, which asserted Show all on this door)
  - "another `?source=` shows only its rows, and Show all clears it"

Measured live: the developer door is the same component opened without `source` (Import 1, New Package 1, platform switch 1, columns including ID and Scope). The Studio app shell itself is NOT MEASURED live, because the fixture runtime does not serve the Studio app ("This app can't be opened").

## Tests

All on `ef65831e5c` unless noted; the pushed head `53503c6a26` is the same tree (only a commit message was reworded).

- `PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx` (new, 16 tests): badge plus href plus click; up to date gives no badge and no summary; 404 gives no badge and no note; counts two apps; 502 gives the note with rows still listed; marketplace disabled gives no catalog read plus the note; apps only are asked; zh badge "有可用更新 → v6.4.0"; namespace loading gives a placeholder; namespace failed gives "→ v6.4.0" plus the link; HotCRM one line, with four modules on demand; two-apps, orphan and code-app modules stay unfolded; search "cpq" shows the module under its app; plus the three door tests above.
- `PackagesPage.source-12675.test.tsx`: one pin replaced, one added (24 tests).
- `marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts`: new `it.each` "%s is drawn only by importers that ask for the namespace themselves (objectstack#34722)" (6 tests).
- Final run: `os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722 PackagesPage.source-12675 marketplaceNamespaceBoundary"`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 46 passed (46).
- Wider related run (earlier head `a175016b49`): PackagesPage.*, ResourceListPage.*, Create/EditPackageDialog, `console/marketplace/__tests__`, spec-symbol-parity, the product-neutral ratchet, the studio and marketplace namespace suites, and en/zh and all-locales parity. 98 files, 1047/1048 passed; the one failure was the source-12675 pin the Q2 decision changes, since fixed.
- Type-check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (tsc and tsconfig.test.json), TC_EXIT=0 on `8fc8e215a5` (`ef65831e5c` adds docs only).

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, each restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

Run with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit x1 to x0, auto-restore, blob verified against HEAD `5356cfce1ec3` of PackagesPage.tsx). These are vitest-from-source suites, so no `dist/` leg applies.

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `updateTarget(...)` replaced by `null` (badge) | 5 failed / 16 |
| catalog failure no longer sets unavailable | 1 failed / 16 |
| marketplace-disabled no longer sets unavailable | 1 failed / 16 |
| `appOfModule` returns null (no folding) | 2 failed / 16 |
| header actions drawn on both doors | 1 failed / 16 |
| namespace-loading no longer holds the placeholder | 1 failed / 16 |
| Show-all chip drawn on both doors | 1 failed / 16 |
| `useMarketplaceNamespace()` call removed (boundary suite) | 2 failed / 6 |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Acceptance 4 is measured on a fixture, not on HotCRM.** The live fold was read on `examples/app-multi-package`, whose served `com.example.multi.orders` row is `{"type":"module","dependencies":{"com.example.multi.core":"^1.0.0"}}`: one module under one app. HotCRM's four-module shape is pinned only in the unit suite. HotCRM itself is NOT MEASURED live.
- **Live readings used a stubbed catalog** (allowed by the brief). The page requests were intercepted to mark the two example rows `source: marketplace` at 6.2.0, with an install-ledger entry `pkg_multi_core` and the catalog answering 6.4.0 / 6.2.0 / 502. Everything else came from the real backend.
- **Modules have no Update cell and no row action.** An app's update covers the modules it brought (ADR-0130 D2). A module row still opens the detail sheet, where Disable lives, as before.
- **Out of scope, observed (class a, user-visible truncation):** on the developer door (`/apps/setup/component/developer/packages`, no `source`) at a 1400 px viewport, the Actions column is clipped by the table's overflow. This is unchanged by this PR (that table branch is untouched). Reach: live screenshot of that URL at 1400x900. Reported to the seat to file. Dedupe words: packages table actions column clipped, overflow, Studio packages.
